title: A user who can only view work orders sees the field as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A colleague whose role lets them only view work orders opens a work order that already has a sales representative.
  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose role has "Work Orders — View" but not "Work Orders — Create & Edit", at {Location-A}.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Viewer with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST SSR View Only; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the field shows as plain text, "Sales Representative" with {Sales-rep-A} under it, with no box, no arrow, no + and no remove x.
  • Step 2: nothing opens; the field cannot be changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”
